paper_title: Searching for an oscillating massive scalar field as a dark matter candidate using atomic hyperfine frequency comparisons
coupling_convention: dimensionless d_e (combination d_e+0.043(d_mhat-d_g), interpreted as d_e for EM-only coupling)
notes: Search for oscillating massive scalar DM via Rb/Cs hyperfine frequency comparison at LNE-SYRTE. Main result (Fig.3) constrains the linear combination d_e + 0.043(d_mhat - d_g) vs scalar mass; when only EM coupling assumed this is d_e (ScalarPhoton). Text gives ceiling <5.3e-4 over the mass range 1e-24 to 1e-18 eV and best limit 3.8e-9 at m=1.4e-23 eV. Intermediate points are rough estimates read from the exclusion curve shape, so limited accuracy. 95% CL. Local DM density 0.4 GeV/cm^3 assumed. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 3, 0, 0.55, 5))
